passage:
The period saw seven rulers, five of them killed, and three places taken from the Wurn League.
It defeated the Wurn League at Laehiford in year 7 and took Laehiford from them. It defeated them again at Hadale in year 20 and took Hadale from them.

corrected:
The period saw seven rulers, five of them killed, and two places taken from the Wurn League.
It defeated the Wurn League at Laehiford in year 7 and took Laehiford from them. It defeated them again at Hadale in year 20 and took Hadale from them.
note: three is the world total; the Kebarrow Compact took two of them
